name: ui-layouts-spotlight
title: Spotlight Effect
description: Three dark feature cards that light up with a radial glow wherever the cursor moves. The light falls off gently and nothing on the cards is interactive.
use: A feature grid needs a subtle focal cue tied to where the pointer is.
avoid: Pointer-driven only, so touch and keyboard users never see the glow.
a11y: Pure pointer decoration: no focusable parts and no reduced-motion guard. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Three stacked dark cards with rounded corners and faint borders, each holding a small bold title and two lines of grey body text. A soft white radial glow sits on one card wherever the cursor is.
behaves: Moving the pointer lights a soft radial patch that tracks it across the cards, brightening the area under the cursor and fading to nothing toward the edges. Nothing is clickable.
customise: ProximitySpotlight, HoverFocusSpotlight, CursorFlowGradient and className are props on the wrapper; glow colour and size are fixed.
weight: light: A mousemove listener updating gradients; no canvas or loop.
